notes.title: Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Have you ever played such a good song that it made Nunu freeze in his tracks? If so, it’s okay we’ve got a fix for that and some of the other issues you may have faced since launch. 


FIXED

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to get stuck at the final sledding sequence. 
[*] Game now pauses when you open your Steam overlay.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing players with AZERTY keyboards to key bind "Equip Flute/Release" to any other key. 
[*] We’ve made improvements so that game stuttering happens less frequently. 
[*] After playing a snazzy melody on your flute, Nunu will no longer be stuck/unable to perform any actions. 
[*] Corrected the spelling of Volibear’s voice actor in the credits. 
[/list]


Thank you for playing Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story and reporting these issues to us! If you come across any other issues or these still persist, please let us know in the Steam forums or via our [url=https://support-riotforge.riotgames.com/hc/en-us/requests/new]Player Support form![/url]

notes.title: Nominate Song of Nunu for Steam Awards 2023
notes.notes:
Calling all cozy gamers! 

This year’s Steam Awards are just around the corner, and nomination season has begun! If you’ve enjoyed frolicking across the Freljord with best buddies Nunu and Willump, be sure to nominate Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story for the Sit Back and Relax category. You’d be our heroes! 

Submit your nominations before the Steam Autumn Sale ends on November 28th, and be ready to cast your ballot when voting begins on December 21st! 

The adventure continues!

notes.title: Song of Nunu review - LoL spinoff hits some bum notes
notes.notes:
The Song of Nunu is a delightful exploration of some of League of Legends' most fascinating lore, though its gameplay often feels more like a stalactite-filled obstacle course than a smooth, Willump-y belly slide across the Freljord's frostscapes. As Tequila Works daintily treads themes of grief and found family through Song of Nunu's story, its overall execution is as clumsy as a yeti's disco. Above all else, though, the studio has excelled at weaving together a cohort of League's most-loved champions, and the ice-forged brotherhood between its two protagonists leaves a lasting impression after the credits roll.

notes.title: Riot has one "very hard rule" about LoL spinoffs and Song of Nunu
notes.notes:
Fans new and old of League of Legends, whether you're coming over from Arcane or have played the MOBA game since its inception, will find something to love in Song of Nunu. We had the chance to talk with Raúl Rubio Munárriz from Tequila Works and Rowan Parker from Riot Forge at Gamescom while taking the game for a spin, and it's abundantly clear that anyone, a die-hard LoL fan or not, can find something to enjoy with Song of Nunu.

notes.title: Riot doesn't want to "kitchen sink" any League of Legends spinoffs
notes.notes:
It's no secret that the League of Legends roster is pretty damn huge. With over 164 playable characters available in the MOBA right now, narrowing down which one should get its own spinoff game is surely no easy task. So, we asked Tequila Works' creative director on the upcoming Song of Nunu, Raúl Rubio Munárriz, and Riot Forge's creative director, Rowan Parker, how you make that very, very hard choice.
